notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The early camera survey through roughly frame 144 and the later traversals were not counted. Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a food-storage drawer left of the stove, separately opens and closes both doors of an overhead cabinet above the range hood, and finally opens and closes a utility drawer right of the stove.
